verdict.rationale: Factory's Droid is itself a coding agent, so it takes the MCP client role; serving tools to other agents as an official MCP server is a different product role. The evidence only shows client-side use (connecting MCP tools to Droid). The automated probe pointing to a /harness/mcp docs page does not describe a server mode such as an `mcp serve` subcommand or a hosted MCP endpoint, so it does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
